description: Source code for RPM calculation in engine control firmware, including RPM measurement, engine state detection, and trigger event handling.

classes.name: RpmCalculator
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating engine RPM, detecting engine states, and handling trigger events.

methods.name: getRpmAcceleration
methods.description: Calculates the acceleration of RPM based on previous and current RPM values.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the engine is stopped or not ready.

methods.name: isCranking
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in cranking state.

methods.name: isSpinningUp
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in spinning-up state.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounterSinceStart
methods.description: Returns the number of revolutions since engine start.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the engine is running.

methods.name: checkIfSpinning
methods.description: Determines if the engine is spinning based on trigger events and timeouts.

methods.name: assignRpmValue
methods.description: Assigns a new RPM value and updates related parameters.

methods.name: setRpmValue
methods.description: Sets RPM value and updates engine state accordingly.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current engine spinning state.

methods.name: onNewEngineCycle
methods.description: Handles logic for a new engine cycle, updating revolution counters.

methods.name: setStopped
methods.description: Sets engine state to stopped and resets counters.

methods.name: setStopSpinning
methods.description: Stops spinning state and sets engine to stopped.
